confirmedSourceBehavior.finding: The 20,000 ms watchdog starts when requestProgramFrame queues a job, before any new frame is drawn. It ends only when the whole request resolves or rejects.

While paused and a PNG job is inFlight, rAF continues. The inFlight filter prevents another audit request, but the frame still executes scene update, reflection submission and composer rendering on each eligible rAF.
The same-frame physical/camera snapshot is frozen before toBlob. There is no await/yield around the synchronous toBlob call and no explicit rendering hold until its asynchronous callback.
When the PNG request fails, the matrix catch retains only the previous ordinary report as partialAudit; the current export report and phase are not attached.
Matrix archive construction and browser download happen after collectProgramMatrix returns. They are not inside the failed per-frame watchdog.

causalScope: Redundant paused render submission while the PNG request waits is proved by exact source execution. Native evidence proves two application-watchdog failures, but their original records cannot localize render/readback/encoding/callback time or prove that redundant draws alone caused the deadline. A final unchanged-resolution, unchanged-deadline native rerun is required.
failureType: application-per-frame-watchdog, distinct from browser automation download wait
